sn52.24:1.1: Imesañ ca panāham āvuso catunnaṃ sati- bhā- bahuāsavānaṃ khayā anāsavam cetovimuttim paññāvimuttim diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī ti Tatruddānam || ||
sn52.24:2.0: Sahassa ca Iddhi atha ca pana || Cetoparicca Ṭhānam etī ti || Paṭidoliko Nānāvimutti || Indriyam Jānan tisso Vijjā ti || || Anuruddhasaṃyuttam aṭṭhamam || ||
